nodes.label: Transformer
nodes.desc: Decoder-only stack of TransformerBlocks with token embeddings, final RMSNorm and a vocab projection head.

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.desc: Multi-head attention with grouped-query attention via n_kv_heads and a persistent KV cache.

nodes.label: FeedForward
nodes.desc: SwiGLU MLP: w2(F.silu(w1(x)) * w3(x)) with hidden dim rounded to a multiple of 256.

nodes.label: RMSNorm
nodes.desc: Root-mean-square normalization used pre-attention, pre-FFN and at the model output.

nodes.label: apply_rotary_emb
nodes.desc: Rotary position embeddings applied to queries and keys as complex multiplications.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.desc: Wraps a SentencePieceProcessor model with BOS/EOS-aware encode and decode.

nodes.label: Llama
nodes.desc: Facade pairing a loaded Transformer with its Tokenizer; exposes completion and chat APIs.

nodes.label: Llama.build
nodes.desc: Static factory that initializes NCCL/model parallelism, reads .pth checkpoints and params.json, and loads state into the Transformer.

nodes.label: generate
nodes.desc: Autoregressive decode loop with temperature/top_p sampling and EOS stopping.

nodes.label: chat_completion
nodes.desc: Formats role-ordered dialogs with [INST]/<<SYS>> tags before calling generate.

nodes.label: sample_top_p
nodes.desc: Nucleus sampling: sorts probabilities, keeps the top-p mass, renormalizes and samples.

nodes.label: example_chat_completion.py
nodes.desc: torchrun entry point that builds a Llama via Llama.build and runs chat_completion over sample dialogs.
